text:
erin: Heads-up: small creative sprint for the benchmark launch. Need compact set for webinar slide, three social sizes, and email hero. 48h mock, final EOD Tue.

Requirements:
- hero diagram (latency vs unit cost) optimized to read at 600px wide
- socials: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 940x788
- accessible SVG for blog (include <title> and <desc>)
- Figma components + export tokens
- two visual variants: A = analyst/data-first, B = brand-forward/illustrative
- filename convention: benchmark_launch_{variant}_{size}_{date}

jordan: On it. I'll create a Figma page and set export presets. Any art direction specifics?

erin: Keep A minimal, chart-first. B uses brand palette + subtle illustration. No vendor logos anywhere.

sam: Data: use medians for latency and cost per 1k tokens across hosted/dedicated/private. Add dashed fallback curve for graceful degradation. CSV uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/bench-data.csv

maria: Legal note: avoid absolute claims. Use "measured savings" or "up to". I'll review final proofs.

nikhil: CTA on all social variants: "Request a demo" with utm_source=social & campaign=benchmark_launch. Ops needs final filenames to map routing.

jordan: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/NEW/benchmark-compact. Artboards: hero-600, social-1200x628, social-1080, social-940x788, blog-svg. Export: png@2x, svg, webp.

figma-bot: Exports queued: hero-600 (png, svg), social-1200x628 (png@2x), social-1080 (png@2x), social-940x788 (webp).

erin: Short copy options to slot in:
A: "Serving wins: lower latency, lower unit cost. See the numbers."
B: "Inference engineered for production  predictable, fast, economical."

jordan: Quick Q: include micro-sparklines for variance under the hero or keep single stat view?

sam: Sparklines ok but small and muted. Don't compete with main chart.

jordan: I'll upload mock-v1 to the Figma page within 48h and attach a PDF proof.

erin: When uploading final assets, include a mapping table in the upload note with filename, variant, size, and utm tag so Eng/OPS can map inbound routes.

maria: I'll check copy/legal after uploads. If we need citations, we'll request the test report before publish.

nikhil: Prioritizing paid-social exports first. :thumbsup:

erin: Thanks team — will review mock v1 and reply with consolidated feedback in-thread.
